case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You pointed to labour and material costs behind your quote, and the filling of your capacity matters just as much. Our three options each come with a longer contract term, which gives your planning a firmer base than a short-term quote can.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your team a longer commitment on ball bearing 6306, and we see room for it because of quality:

Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Since this needs a decision on your side, could you take Option A to the person who decides at your company? We would like to find a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Please note that as a distributor, we do not provide internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our current defect rate for you is about 150 ppm. This offer represents our firm position based on current market conditions, and we are fully authorized to manage and conclude this negotiation.

Our current Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Valid for 30 days.

We can accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms, for which we offer a revised unit price of €4.90. This alternative option offers a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

You told us that material is the weight in your calculation and that you want a firm position.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your team the longest-running volume base at a payment term that suits both family companies, and we would be glad to settle on it together.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since you decide on this together with your colleagues, please take Option A up with the person who signs off on your side.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer, but the proposed price remains well below our limits. You mentioned a volume base; to consider further price adjustments, we require concrete data on your projected volumes. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

As previously stated, we are fully authorized to conclude this negotiation, and we can offer a slight adjustment to €4.89 for the 24-month term with 45-day payment. 

Specifically, our main offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer is valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
